author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
I'm sure you all know this problem... You've spent HOURS painting a mini you're super proud of but then you go to take a picture of it and it just somehow doesnt do your masterpiece justice 

Well thats where this video comes in!! 

I absolutely love mini painting but I also LOVE Miniature photography and in this video im going to show you how I achieve the glossy, editorial level scenic, in-world miniature shots which I used to produce for Games Workshop and which I still produce for my own Rascaltown Mini range now!! 

I'll cover everything from set-up, lighting, photography, editing and even how to add in your own special effects without the need for expensive equipment so you can take the BEST photos of your minis EVER!!
title: You can Take the BEST Miniature Photos Ever! | Photography, Editing, Special FX and MORE!
